items.raw_excerpt: A Danish SS soldier was a sperm donor in the 1960s thanks to Sweden's Karolinska hospital. He is the biological father to at least 15 children who now want to know if they are the result of an ideological racial project.
items.summary_en: A Danish soldier who served in the SS donated sperm in Sweden in the 1960s. He may be the biological father of at least 15 children. They now want to know if they were part of an ideological racial project.
items.summary_ko: 나치 친위대원이었던 덴마크 병사가 1960년대 스웨덴의 카롤린스카 병원에서 정자 기증을 했다. 그는 최소 15명 아이들의 생물학적 아버지일 수 있으며, 아이들은 자신들이 이념적 인종 사업의 결과물인지 알고 싶어 한다.
items.title_en: Danish Nazi became sperm donor in Sweden, his children want answers
items.title_ko: 덴마크 나치 병사, 1960년대 스웨덴에서 정자 기증자였다

items.raw_excerpt: Switzerland has three official languages, but when it comes to public announcements on its trains, English has taken precedence over some of them.
items.summary_en: Switzerland has three official languages. But English has come first in some train announcements. The choice has surprised many locals.

items.title_en: Switzerland's trains announce in English before local languages

items.raw_excerpt: Residents of the Rotterdam neighbourhood De Esch say the nights have been quiet since a ban on entering the area took effect two weeks ago, but fear the disruption will return when it runs out in October. A curfew for anyone without a good reason for being in the area was imposed on July 23, making it an offence to be on the streets from 11pm till 5am. The unprecedented move follows years of persistent anti-social behaviour in the area,...
items.summary_en: A neighbourhood in Rotterdam stopped people from being on the streets late at night. Neighbours say the nights have been quiet since the ban started two weeks ago. They fear the trouble will come back when the ban ends in October.
items.summary_ko: 로테르담의 한 동네에서 밤에 길에 나서는 것을 금지했습니다. 금지 조치가 시작된 뒤 주민들은 밤이 조용해졌다고 말합니다. 하지만 조치가 10월에 끝나면 문제가 다시 돌아올까 봐 걱정합니다.
items.title_en: Rotterdam night ban brings quiet streets, residents want it kept

items.raw_excerpt: At least 31 cruise ships carrying more than 50,000 passengers are expected around Iceland for the August 12 total solar eclipse.
items.summary_en: At least 31 cruise ships will bring more than 50,000 passengers to Iceland. They are coming to see the total solar eclipse on August 12. It will be the largest cruise fleet ever seen around Iceland.
items.summary_ko: 크루즈선 최소 31척이 5만 명이 넘는 승객을 태우고 아이슬란드 주변 해역을 찾을 예정입니다. 모두 8월 12일 개기일식을 보기 위해서입니다. 아이슬란드 연안을 찾는 크루즈 함대 가운데 역대 최대 규모입니다.
items.title_en: Record Cruise Fleet Heads to Iceland for Total Solar Eclipse

items.raw_excerpt: No falta nada... la cartelera de fondas para las Fiestas Patrias 2026
items.summary_en: The lineup of fondas for Chile's 2026 Fiestas Patrias is here. Traditional venues will offer food, drinks, and music for the national holiday. This is a guide to the best places to celebrate.

items.raw_excerpt: People living in the Veluwe region near the German border have been surprised by the sight of a zeppelin hovering in the skies above their heads. The airship took off from Essen, in the Ruhr area of North Rhine-Westphalia, and is being used to measure air pollution in an area on both sides of the border that covers Arnhem and Utrecht. Scientists from Wageningen University & Research have equipped the balloon with instruments to measure levels of CO2 pollution, emissions...
items.summary_en: People in the Veluwe region were surprised to see a zeppelin in the sky. The German airship flies over the border to measure air pollution near Arnhem and Utrecht. Scientists from Wageningen University put instruments on it to check CO2 levels.
items.summary_ko: 벨뤼베 지역 주민들이 하늘에 떠 있는 체펠린 비행선을 보고 놀랐습니다. 독일의 비행선이 국경을 넘어 아른헴과 위트레흐트 인근의 대기 오염을 측정하고 있습니다. 바게닝언 대학교 과학자들이 이 기구에 이산화탄소 농도를 재는 장치를 달았습니다.
items.title_en: Zeppelin surprises Dutch villagers while measuring air pollution

items.raw_excerpt: It's not quite the famed '€1 homes', but a local authority in central France is selling off 12 homes starting at €80,000.
items.summary_en: A local authority in central France is selling 12 homes starting at 80,000 euros. The homes are cheaper than average, but not as famous as the '1-euro homes'. It is a small town effort to bring in new residents.

items.raw_excerpt: Many Adelaide couples are scrambling to find a new venue for their weddings after a popular restaurant and cellar door announced its "unexpected" closure.
items.summary_en: A popular restaurant and cellar door in Adelaide said it would close without warning. Many local couples must now find a new place for their wedding. They are rushing to find another venue before their dates arrive.

items.summary_en: People in Mérida are proud after the city was named the best small city in the world by a travel media outlet. The article shares reasons to visit the city in Yucatán, Mexico.
